# Browser dependencies

`qrcodegen.js` is the MIT-licensed QR Code generator library by Project Nayuki,
downloaded on 2026-11-05 from
https://www.nayuki.io/res/qr-code-generator-library/qrcodegen.js.
The original copyright and license header is preserved.

SHA-256: `2511bc17f40a3c41d4a0578995db956b38997334d3d20113a5d4dc5c49c69480`.

The ZIP launch result uses this bundled script to encode preview URLs locally.
It does not contact a third-party QR service or modify the downloadable ZIP.
